questions.question: What is Copilot Pages?
options: A persistent, editable canvas that turns a Copilot Chat response into content you can edit, add to, share, and work on with others
A read-only transcript of your chat history
A feature that exports a Copilot response as a static PDF
A separate note-taking app unrelated to Copilot Chat
questions.explanation: Copilot Pages takes Copilot-generated content and puts it on a dynamic, persistent canvas you can edit, add to, share, and co-edit in real time.

questions.question: Content in a Copilot Page is saved and stored, so you can leave and come back to keep editing it rather than losing it when the chat session ends.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Pages are durable and reusable because their content is stored (in SharePoint Embedded), so it persists after the chat session rather than disappearing.

questions.question: Who can see a new Copilot Page by default?
options: Only you; it is private until you choose to share it, similar to OneDrive
Everyone in your organization automatically
Your manager and team by default
Anyone on the public internet
questions.explanation: A Copilot Page is private by default and is not shared or co-authored until you choose to share it, much like OneDrive.

questions.question: Select all that are part of real-time collaboration on a Copilot Page.
options: Live editing by more than one person
Presence indicators showing who is on the page
Shared cursors
A locked mode where only one person can edit at a time
Manually merging separate private copies later
questions.explanation: Real-time collaboration includes live editing, presence indicators, and shared cursors. Pages are not locked to one editor, and there are no separate copies to merge.

questions.question: When you share a Copilot Page, what access can you grant?
options: Either edit or read-only access, using a company-wide link or a people-specific link
Only full edit rights; read-only sharing is not possible
Only by sending the page as an email attachment
Sharing always shares your entire notebook, not just the one page
questions.explanation: You can grant edit or read-only access and choose a company-wide or people-specific link, depending on your organization's sharing settings.

questions.question: Select all that are true about how Copilot Pages support a knowledge-creation workflow.
options: Its content is saved and persists, so you can leave and return to keep editing
It is private by default until you choose to share it
It disappears as soon as you close the Copilot Chat window
It is stored only in your browser cache on one device
questions.explanation: Pages turn ephemeral chat into durable, shareable content: the content persists and is private by default. It does not vanish when you close chat, and it is not just browser cache.
